mapStructuralStability: Lotus is structurally stable: minor art/wall fixes (e.g. v12.05 attacker-lobby wall thickened). Unique gimmicks: destructible ROTATING doors (A/C) and rope ASCENDERS. No site/route rework. Meta driver is agent balance.

Cypher 's Spycam can no longer be placed on doors

Minor art fixes around the map.

dataWindowRecommendation.rationale: Lotus intl sample 145 maps; >=9.x=89, >=11.x=48, >=13.x=15. Same logic as Ascent (structurally stable; agent-balance-driven). Note Lotus was added later than Ascent so its early-era sample is smaller.
